title: "Rails Magic" Isn't Magic. How a Request Actually Travels Through Rails.
why_read: A clear walkthrough of how Rails actually processes a request internally, useful for developers who want to demystify the framework's 'magic.'
analysis: The article traces a request's path through Rails's internals, covering Rack middleware, Zeitwerk's autoloading mechanism, how ActiveRecord reflects database schema into model attributes, and how controller instance variables become available in views. This kind of under-the-hood explanation is valuable for intermediate Rails developers who use these features daily without understanding their implementation. It's a solid educational piece though it covers fairly well-documented territory for experienced Rails engineers.
